about: The check code PACK_CHECKS was set for (scripts/test-packs.mjs fingerprints it): change the check, bump PACK_CHECKS in public/js/study/pack-format.js and set both here.
changed: 12 Nov 2026: a pack's languageDef (a language Lexicommons doesn't list: an ISO 639 code we don't list, private use x-…, or a dialect of one of ours, <code>-x-…; its name, direction, written with or without spaces, case and own sentence ends). A pack checked under 15 can't have kept the field (it was left out with a warning, and its language was refused), so a proof under 15 still holds (pack-format.js proofStillGood) and no stored pack is checked again for it. Before that, 11 Nov 2026 (no bump): pack-items.js gamesOf gives a plain item Say it when its caller says its text can be asked aloud (a `says` option and a length limit, ITEM_LIMITS.said); which games an item plays is no part of what the check accepts, so every proof under 15 still holds. Before that, 10 Nov 2026 (no bump): an item whose words list the check refuses (too long, not a list, empty) is no longer also refused for its text and its gap against what was left of that list; it was refused before and is refused now, so nothing it accepts changed and every proof under 15 still holds. Before that, 9 Nov 2026 (no bump): the warning for one written word with two readings in a sentence taken out, since your AI's form now keeps each time's reading (pack-authoring.js); a warning never decided what's kept, so every proof under 15 still holds. Before that, 8 Nov 2026: a pack's teaches: "script" (a pack that teaches how a script is read, Japanese's kana: every item a card of a letter and how it's said, no sentences, gaps or lessons; its deck's games ask how it's said: study/deck.js). A pack checked under 14 can't have kept the field (it was left out with a warning), so a proof under 14 still holds (pack-format.js proofStillGood) and no stored pack is checked again for it.
